published.source: Tauren, Nature's Focus pushback and the client 70425 racials (2026-10-16)

summary: The Balance build keeping Faerie Fire on the boss for the raid. Moonkin gets nothing from the armor, so the duty costs the GCDs spent on it.
rotation: Pre-pull: Starfire (rank 6) cast 3s before the pull so it lands at 0
Racials, potions and runes on cooldown (Innervate on its own trigger)
Faerie Fire on the target first after the pull, again once it has under 1.5s left
Insect Swarm whenever it is down (more than 8s of fight left)
Moonfire whenever its dot is down (more than 8s of fight left)
Starfire when Clearcasting is up (Wrath does not use it up)
Moonfire when a Starfire would not land before the end
Wrath when Eclipse is at 2 charges or fewer and no Wrath is in flight
caveats: Costs 32.4 / 30.7 / 28.7 DPS against the base build at 120s / 180s / 300s.
Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 36 spell power and 15 crit rating, and an on-use 140 spell power for 20s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
No Ahn'Qiraj ranks: Starfire rank 6 costs 13.3 DPS at 180s.
5-piece Grovekeeper Eclipse instead of 2-piece would add 12.6 and Swarming Idol is worth 3.3 (measured before the 5a and 1b rounds)
At 300s mana runs out, and the plain weave without the Clearcasting Starfire is 2 ahead.
Wrath VIII's base damage is ×1.085, halfway to the level 30 rank's 0.42 of Era (only ranks 1 to 5 were retuned). The client has ×1.00.
Unverified: Omen of Clarity's proc chance on spells, and Eclipse charges on Wrath landing.
One +2% crit elixir per character. A second one (Owl) would add 15.1.
notes: druid__balance.json with the raid's Faerie Fire and Curse of Recklessness off (Forever's two share the minor armor slot, standards 20, so with the curse on the druid's own Faerie Fire adds nothing) and the level60_ff rotation. Everything else is the base request.
